meta.name: accessibility-compliance
meta.description: Implement WCAG 2.2 compliant interfaces with mobile accessibility, inclusive design patterns, and assistive technology support. Use when auditing accessibility, implementing ARIA patterns, building for screen readers, or ensuring inclusive user experiences.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让网页对残障人士友好可用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在开发网站或应用,需要确保它们能被所有人使用。
copy.tagline_en: Make your web pages usable by everyone, including people with disabilities.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you develop websites and need to ensure they are usable by all people.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 WCAG 2.2 标准编写和修改网页代码:给按钮、弹窗、表单加无障碍属性,支持键盘操作和读屏软件,并检查颜色对比度、焦点顺序等。
howto.when: 当你要做无障碍审计、实现 ARIA 模式、面向屏幕阅读器开发等需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我审计这个页面的无障碍问题,按 WCAG 2.2 列出来。
say.note: Claude 会检查常见违规并给出修复建议。

say.text: 给我写一个支持键盘操作和屏幕阅读器的可访问弹窗。
say.note: 会包含焦点控制和 ARIA 标记。

say.text: 把这段表单改成符合无障碍标准的写法,加上错误提示。
say.note: 返回带标签和错误提示的表单代码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will write and modify web code according to WCAG 2.2: adding ARIA attributes to buttons, dialogs, and forms, supporting keyboard operation and screen readers, and checking color contrast, focus order, and similar issues.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to audit accessibility, implement ARIA patterns, build for screen readers, or ensure inclusive user experiences.

say_en.text: Audit this page for accessibility issues and list WCAG 2.2 violations.
say_en.note: Claude reviews the code and suggests fixes.

say_en.text: Write an accessible modal dialog with keyboard and screen reader support.
say_en.note: Includes focus trap and ARIA labels.

say_en.text: Rewrite this form with proper labels, ARIA attributes, and inline error messages.
say_en.note: Returns accessible form markup with error reporting.
